hypothesis: For exactly equal BM25 scores, newer cutoff-safe documents are a safer cross-family tie-break than lexicographic doc_id order.

reason: All three exact-tie families recover the newer relevant document, every public top-three result and answer byte is preserved, all 116 tests pass, and recency never overrides a relevance-score difference.
